name: Fair Isle
description: Fair Isle knitting: rows of V stitches charted into a band of stepped diamonds between plain stripes, three colors to the piece.

code.style: --rule: ( --k0: @pd(@p(var(--color1), var(--color2))); --k1: @pd(@p(var(--color3), var(--color4))); --k2: @pd(@p(var(--color5), var(--color6))); --n: @pd(@p(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)); --k: @match(y % 8 == 0, @var(--k2), abs((x + @lp()) % 6 - 3) + abs(y % 8 - 4) <= 2, @var(--k1), @var(--k0)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 13%; top: -10%; width: 36%; height: 120%; background-color: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--leg); clip-path: @var(--leg); -webkit-transform: rotate(-20deg); transform: rotate(-20deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 51%; top: -10%; width: 36%; height: 120%; background-color: @var(--k); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--leg); clip-path: @var(--leg); -webkit-transform: rotate(20deg); transform: rotate(20deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --leg: @shape(split: 120; x: sin(t) * abs(sin(t))^.6; y: cos(t) * .98); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
